correctness.rationale: Domination is classified by selected side occupancies: >=2 on each; one selected on one side requires its matched mate on other; or a full side. The complementary induced K_pq minus matching disconnects exactly in singleton matched-side cases and p=q=c=2, plus one-sided non-singletons. Correcting overlaps yields the polynomial; n=3 complement of any matched pair is C_2 crown (two disjoint edges), whereas for n>=4 Cr_(n-1) is connected. Independent brute connectivity/subset count for n=3..7 matched coefficients and totals.

originality.rationale: The full original outer-connected domination polynomial article covers paths, cycles, stars, joins and wheels but does not provide the crown family. Previous complete multipartite theorems do not specialize: deleting a perfect matching destroys the graph-class condition and changes the n=3 minimum.
residual_risks: Earlier outer-connected domination work under crown, cocktail-party bipartite or K_nn-M aliases may contain the same coefficient formula.

value.rationale: A complete coefficient formula and sharp small-size phase transition for a canonical matching-deleted bipartite graph extend a natural established domination polynomial and encode all admissible set sizes, not only one extremum.
